# Resource: yet_settings_apps

Which apps the company's people see. Every app is on but those listed in `off`; an app Yet adds later comes on.

~> **Note:** Destroying this resource leaves the apps as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every app on, but these.
resource "yet_settings_apps" "acme" {
  off = ["sketch", "agile"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `off` (Set of String) The apps turned off: any of `mail`, `hello`, `calls`, `calendar`, `paper`, `cells`, `sketch`, `agents`, `drive`, `agile`, `vault`, `cloud`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The company's slug.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, with an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

```terraform
import {
  to = yet_settings_apps.acme
  id = "acme"
}
```

With [`terraform import`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

```shell
terraform import yet_settings_apps.acme acme
```
